name: chekhov-correspondence
description: Anton Chekhov's letters — public-domain test fixture for the drafting path.
register: dialogic, one named recipient, 1890s translated Russian
notes: FIXTURE, not a real user's profile. It is built from public-domain text so
that `voice-profile-render` can be exercised end to end without anyone's
own writing in the repo. Nothing here describes a person who uses this tool.
The text is Constance Garnett's English translation. Punctuation, idiom and
sentence joinery are therefore partly the translator's, not Chekhov's, and
any voice observation derived from this corpus inherits that caveat.
